evaluator.claimBoundary: This is an agent trial against the M0 contract, accepted as the M1 comparison baseline by delegated user authorization. It is not a teacher evaluation or evidence of classroom effectiveness.

reviewReceipt.scope: M1 fixed cases, Rubric v0.1, baseline findings and M1 gate
reviewReceipt.boundary: The user will review the final result after delivery; the authorization does not fabricate teacher or teaching-researcher calibration.

artifactCaseScores.blockingEvidence: The cross-shape task draws a triangle split into two equal halves, shades one half, labels it as 1/4, and says all four figures represent 1/4.
artifactCaseScores.visualEvidence: 13 of 15 screens exceed 900px height at a 1440x900 viewport; minimum visible leaf font is 13.6px; the triangle visual is mathematically misleading.

No horizontal overflow and minimum visible leaf font is 19.2px, but screens 2, 9 and 10 exceed the 900px classroom viewport; the optional comparison is needed to bring the listed activities from 38 to 40 minutes.

artifactCaseScores.blockingEvidence: The run exceeded 600000ms, was stopped, and produced no Artifact.

The first average-partition question draws a one-quarter sector but the answer calls it an equal half; the activity table totals about 43 minutes without the optional comparison and 45 minutes with it despite a 40-minute constraint.
artifactCaseScores.visualEvidence: All 21 screens fit 1440x900 with no horizontal overflow and minimum visible leaf font is 16px, but the incorrect sector diagram creates a mathematical meaning error.

aggregate.interpretation: The score is a first rubric result for this fixed suite, not the project's 20/75 maturity coordinate and not a classroom-effectiveness measurement.

clarificationCases.finding: Asked for the missing duration but added three unnecessary questions whose answers were already constrained by the task.
Explained that class level matters but did not ask for it, then offered to assume a default profile despite an explicit no-guess instruction.
Detected the conflict but retained 几分之几 in the proposed first-lesson flow and supplied unsupported or wrong grade-placement claims.
Correctly requested scope information but asserted a seventh-unit location that conflicts with the verified 2022 second-edition eighth-unit baseline.

clarificationSummary.interpretation: V1 generally knows when to pause, but minimal questioning, non-invention and curriculum-boundary accuracy are not stable.

majorLossAreas: Mathematical diagrams are not coupled to answer verification, producing blocking visual-answer contradictions.
Curriculum locations and grade progressions are invented during clarification even when the correct response is to preserve UNKNOWN.
One of four artifact tasks exceeded the 10-minute runtime limit, showing that one-shot full-HTML generation is not reliably bounded.
Time budgets are copied as labels but not consistently arithmetically reconciled.
Classroom pages are either over-dense and scroll-dependent or expanded to too many sparse screens.
Clarification is often broader than the minimum necessary and may reintroduce defaults after a no-guess instruction.
